grandparents_cupboard.reason: Butter, sugar, golden syrup, oats, seeds, sultanas and apples are all ordinary cupboard and garden foods.

supermarket.reason: Every ingredient is an everyday item at any mainstream supermarket.

basic_kitchen.reason: Needs only a pan, a square tin and a grater, and the technique is simple melting and mixing.

works.reason: The ratios suit an apple flapjack: 300g oats bound by 150g butter, sugar and syrup, baked 30 to 35 minutes at 180°C, giving 16 bars.

honest_times.reason: Fifteen minutes is enough to grate two apples, melt, mix and press, and 35 minutes cooking matches the bake.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed ingredient and seasoning is used, the sultanas match the raisins-or-sultanas id, and nothing unlisted appears.

seasonal_feel.reason: Stored apples suit early March, and the grated apple runs through the bars rather than sitting on top as a garnish.

plain_voice.reason: The steps are clear and homely British English with no restaurant language or preaching.

hearty_healthy.reason: An oat-based bar with fruit and seeds and modest sugar is a sensible homemade family snack.
